title: A function can call another function defined in the same query
query: FUNCTION AddTaxAndDiscount = ( amount : NUMERIC, discount : NUMERIC ) => AddTax ( amount - discount )

source.quote: You can nest UDFs by calling a function from another.
source.supports: the page shows this query with the comment "Returns 8.8"

notes: The type is left out: it depends on the type of the literal 1.1, which the page does not state.
